items.title: Bernstein backs these 2 metals and mining stocks amid market volatility
items.summary: Investing.com -- Bernstein has identified its top picks in the metals and mining sector following a significant market sell-off last week that hit commodity prices and equities hard. Freeport was among the worst 10 performing stocks in the S&P 500, alongside AI-focused names such as NVDA, as copper and gold prices fell significantly.

items.title: Freeport McMoRan (FCX) Stock Looks Like A Bargain After A Sharp Selloff
items.summary: Freeport-McMoRan has seen its share price pull back sharply in recent weeks after a strong multi year climb. This puts a fresh spotlight on whether the current US$49.12 level is still supported by the cash the business can generate over time. Over the past 3 years the stock has returned 38.2%, which puts real weight on the question of how much of that move its future cash flows can reasonably support.
